title: Digital Apothecary
subtitle: >Led by Dr. Moya Bailey, housed at Northwestern University
why: Making social justice salves for the digital and using the digital to make salves for social justice
description: The Digital Apothecary is a hybrid digital and physical lab dedicated to combining ancient and new technologies in an effort to produce processes and projects that aid those most marginalized in society. It is a place for applied research that goes beyond theory.
